timing_contract: Same soil-sampling occasion; Corg, sampling depth and pH are measured covariates available before BD inference. This is a laboratory-measurement substitution task, not a future forecast.
calibration: No held-out country BD calibration; country identifiers are grouping metadata, never predictors.
independent_unit: Entire country/site portfolio, with all transects, fields and depths linked. Eight countries are convenience samples, not a random population sample.

scope_limits: Texture is unavailable in six countries and excluded rather than imputed. C stocks are excluded because they use bulk density algebraically.; Observational associations do not identify an agroforestry treatment effect. Protocol adaptations and country effects may limit transfer.
